program_name: Master of Landscape Architecture - MLA Graduate profile

programme_facts.value: Award-winning campus providing a safe and supportive environment for students.
Blends lush parkland, riverside walkways, and wildlife with modern learning spaces, creating a peaceful yet inspiring environment for students.
UL Global assists all international students coming to UL under various programmes including Postgraduate, Undergraduate, Study Abroad, Erasmus+, Exchange and Summer School programmes.
Erasmus+ EU Staff Training mobility can be completed by attending a Staff Week organized by one of UL's partner universities.

programme_facts.value: Staff Weeks are designed to give an overview of the host university's institution and departments, while bringing together teaching and non-teaching staff to share ideas and potentially establish connections for future collaboration.
